scenes.line1: Can you track every model change?
scenes.say: If you can't track every tweak, how will you know which model actually works? Let's see why experiment tracking and model registries matter.

scenes.label: Tracking
scenes.sub: Records parameters, metrics, and artifacts for each run.
scenes.say: Experiment tracking logs what you tried, your settings, and results for every model run. That makes comparing and reproducing experiments easy.

rows.b: Store and track each model version
Keep details like metrics and params
Move models from staging to production

scenes.say: A model registry keeps your models organized. It stores versions, their details, and lets you promote models safely from staging to production.

scenes.title: Track and register models
scenes.say: With MLflow, you log experiment settings and manage model versions. You can promote models to production right from the registry.

scenes.question: Why use a model registry?
scenes.right: To manage model versions, metadata, and lifecycle stages for safe deployment.
scenes.say: Interviewers want to know you use a registry to manage model versions and promote models safely, not just to store data.
